item.title: Correction · 1670 Owens Garage: The record said UCSF land is not on the Assessor's secured roll…
item.description: The record said UCSF land is not on the Assessor's secured roll and that the year built came only from PropertyShark. DataSF's Assessor roll carries 1670 Owens St as parcel 8709022 (garage, built 2010, 7 stories, College/University exemption), and DBI permit 200801243180 is complete as of 2010-01-29 and describes an 823-space, 6-story garage. The completion date, summary, open questions and map caveat now cite these instead of PropertyShark (which blocks automated fetches), the notes now say 823 spaces rather than an unconfirmed ~820, and an 823-space capacity fact was added. 'UCSF's garage opposite Kaiser with a C Street entrance' is noted as not confirmed by cited sources. The $52.8M cost entry now cites the DataSF permit records, the NAIP aerial credit names the USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural. Source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8709022 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8709022); DataSF Building Permits, permit #200801243180 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200801243180); USDA NAIP imagery catalog record (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/national-agriculture-imagery-program-naip-imagery); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Added · 1670 Owens Garage: DBI permit 200801243180 (6-story, 823-space garage at 1670 Owens St)…
item.description: DBI permit 200801243180 (6-story, 823-space garage at 1670 Owens St) gives a revised cost of $52,800,000 and an estimated cost of $17,900,000 (DataSF building permits); the permit's initial filed estimate was lower, noted for context. No UCSF- or Regents-stated project budget was found. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200801243180.

item.title: Complete · 1670 Owens Garage: DBI recorded the garage's construction permit (6… (Jan 29, 2010)
item.description: DBI recorded the garage's construction permit (6 stories, 823 spaces) complete on 2010-01-29; the Assessor roll gives 2010 as the year built (PropertyShark, the aggregator first cited, also says 2010 but could not be read in the audit) (Jan 29, 2010). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection; DataSF / SF Office of the Assessor-Recorder.
